expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses 'raw mode 没有在所有退出路径上恢复' and lists missed paths (错误提前退出, panic, 信号, Ctrl-D/EOF) plus minimal fixes: 'C：atexit(disableRawMode) + 捕获 SIGINT/SIGTERM 后 exit()'; 'Rust：Drop guard（RAII）'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with '把你的编辑器源码放进这个工作区（或告诉我路径），我帮你定位...' — no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour given

expectations.text: B3: Explains original termios must be saved and restored on exit (atexit/disableRawMode)
expectations.evidence: 'tcsetattr 恢复正常模式的代码只在正常退出时执行了' and '标准修法是把恢复挂在“必然执行”的位置：C：atexit(disableRawMode)' — explains restoring original terminal settings on exit via atexit/disableRawMode

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only command run was 'ls -la .../build-your-own-x-text-editor-2' (read-only, inside project dir); FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); no install commands (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install) present
